description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android application. The activity hosts a WebView that displays an HTML content info page, passing metadata via Intent extras and a JavaScript bridge. It manages focus restoration on back navigation and constructs a payload JSON to pass to the WebView. It also includes intent building utilities.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android FragmentActivity that hosts a WebView displaying content info, passing metadata via Intent extras and a JavaScript bridge. Handles focus restoration and JSON payload construction.

methods.name: buildIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to start ContentInfoActivity with metadata extras.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, configures the WebView, and loads the local HTML asset with payload.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back and enter key events, restoring focus or passing focus restore data.

methods.name: deliverFocusRestoreResult
methods.description: Sets activity result with focus position indices for restoring focus later.

methods.name: configureWebView
methods.description: Configures WebView settings and sets up JavaScript bridge.

methods.name: buildPayloadJson
methods.description: Constructs a JSON string containing metadata to be passed to the WebView.
